notes: The legacy slots/templates fields remain unchanged for backward compatibility.
The new input_schema is generated from existing scalar slots; no unsupported array/object fields were fabricated.
A separate dynamic-table example demonstrates nested arrays for future GUI-created definitions.
NLU intent detection and natural-language extraction are not solved by JSON Schema, JSONata, or Jinja2; the runtime still needs a generic extractor/model/parser.
The transform expression '$' is an identity transformation, not a domain-specific algorithm.
